serverInfo.name: gouda-studios-agent-tools
serverInfo.title: Gouda Studios Agent Tools
serverInfo.description: MCP server for Gouda Studios data tools: federal contracts, SEC filings, awards, company LEI, contacts, YouTube transcripts, and Google Trends.

initialize.instructions:
Gouda Studios Agent Tools exposes seven data Actors plus helpers to inspect runs and datasets.
Actor tools start a run and return results. Use get-actor-run, get-dataset-items, and get-key-value-store-record to read run output. Use abort-actor-run to stop an in-progress run.

tools.title: Get Actor run
tools.description: Returns status, storages, stats, and a short summary for one Actor run. Use after starting a run, or with waitSecs to wait for a terminal status.

waitSecs.description: Seconds to wait for the run to finish (0-45).

actorId.description: Stable Apify Actor ID from the run record

status.description: Run status: READY | RUNNING | TIMING-OUT | TIMED-OUT |.

exitCode.description: Actor process exit code; populated for terminal states.

startedAt.description: ISO timestamp when the run started

finishedAt.description: ISO timestamp when the run finished (terminal states only)
